Spoofing.title: Weak Authentication Mechanism
Spoofing.description: System uses weak or no authentication, allowing attackers to impersonate legitimate users
Spoofing.mitigation: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) and strong password policies
Spoofing.detection: Monitor failed login attempts and unusual access patterns

Spoofing.title: Session Token Theft
Spoofing.description: Session tokens transmitted insecurely or stored improperly
Spoofing.mitigation: Use HTTPS, secure cookies, implement token rotation
Spoofing.detection: Monitor for concurrent sessions from different locations

Tampering.title: Data Manipulation in Transit
Tampering.description: Attacker intercepts and modifies data during transmission
Tampering.mitigation: Use TLS/SSL for all communications, implement message signing
Tampering.detection: Implement integrity checks and anomaly detection

Tampering.title: SQL Injection
Tampering.description: Malicious SQL code injected through user inputs
Tampering.mitigation: Use parameterized queries, input validation, ORM frameworks

Repudiation.title: Insufficient Logging
Repudiation.description: Critical actions not logged, preventing audit trails
Repudiation.mitigation: Implement comprehensive logging, use centralized log management
Repudiation.detection: Regular log audits and compliance checks

Information Disclosure.title: Sensitive Data Exposure
Information Disclosure.description: Sensitive data transmitted or stored without encryption
Information Disclosure.mitigation: Encrypt data at rest and in transit, implement data classification

Information Disclosure.title: API Information Leakage
Information Disclosure.description: API responses contain excessive or sensitive information
Information Disclosure.mitigation: Implement response filtering, minimize data exposure

Denial of Service.title: Resource Exhaustion
Denial of Service.description: Attacker overwhelms system resources causing service disruption
Denial of Service.mitigation: Implement rate limiting, auto-scaling, DDoS protection

Elevation of Privilege.title: Privilege Escalation
Elevation of Privilege.mitigation: Implement least privilege, regular access reviews, RBAC
Elevation of Privilege.detection: Monitor privilege changes, unusual admin activity

owasp_top10.title: Broken Access Control
owasp_top10.description: Restrictions on authenticated users not properly enforced
owasp_top10.mitigation: Implement proper authorization checks, deny by default

owasp_top10.title: Cryptographic Failures
owasp_top10.description: Sensitive data exposed due to weak or missing encryption
owasp_top10.mitigation: Use strong encryption algorithms, proper key management

owasp_top10.title: Injection
owasp_top10.description: Untrusted data sent to interpreter as part of command or query
owasp_top10.mitigation: Use parameterized queries, input validation, escaping

ai_llm_threats.title: Prompt Injection
ai_llm_threats.description: Malicious prompts manipulate LLM to bypass safety controls
ai_llm_threats.mitigation: Input sanitization, prompt templates, output filtering
ai_llm_threats.detection: Monitor for unusual prompt patterns, output anomalies

ai_llm_threats.title: Training Data Poisoning
ai_llm_threats.description: Malicious data injected into training set to compromise model
ai_llm_threats.mitigation: Data validation, provenance tracking, model monitoring
ai_llm_threats.detection: Model behavior analysis, performance degradation monitoring

ai_llm_threats.title: Model Inversion Attack
ai_llm_threats.description: Attacker extracts training data from model outputs
ai_llm_threats.mitigation: Differential privacy, output filtering, access controls
ai_llm_threats.detection: Query pattern analysis, unusual inference requests

ai_llm_threats.title: Insecure Plugin/Tool Use
ai_llm_threats.description: LLM uses external tools without proper validation
ai_llm_threats.detection: Monitor tool invocations, unexpected API calls

ai_llm_threats.title: Sensitive Data Leakage
ai_llm_threats.description: LLM inadvertently exposes sensitive information in responses
ai_llm_threats.mitigation: Data filtering, PII detection, response sanitization

cloud_threats.title: Misconfigured S3 Bucket
cloud_threats.description: Cloud storage publicly accessible due to misconfiguration
cloud_threats.mitigation: Enable bucket policies, block public access, regular audits

cloud_threats.title: Excessive IAM Permissions
cloud_threats.description: Overly permissive IAM roles grant unnecessary access
cloud_threats.mitigation: Implement least privilege, regular permission reviews
cloud_threats.detection: IAM access analyzer, unused permission detection
